views.hero: Continuous low rounded chamber chain follows an S curve, joined by narrow connectors on quiet full-thickness slab. No detached balls or transparent surface concealment.
views.reversehero: Reverse lighting reveals faceted low lobes and narrow continuous connections. Solid side edge intact; no coplanar layered flicker apparent in this static view.
views.front: All thirteen low lobe peaks are individually readable across the slab edge profile. Each meets the host; no floating components.
views.side: Natural projection overlap compresses the chain into a small cluster; this view supports height and slab contact, not a false thirteen-count claim.
views.rear: Thirteen low lobes and full host thickness retained. No underside breakthrough or detached parallel overlay visible.
views.top: One unbranched S-shaped row of thirteen rounded chambers, visibly narrower necks; not hearts, animal segmentation or branching anatomy.
views.clay: Rounded chambers and thin connectors remain discernible without the trace color, establishing true relief rather than a material-only line.
views.silhouette: Quiet slab dominates the outer contour as expected for interior shallow relief. This frame is not claimed as chamber identification evidence.

concept_observation: All four original panels inspected. Generated giant ball height and noisy rock are intentionally not copied; original premodel corrections are preserved. Concept remains design input, not factual evidence.
reference_observation: The original PRI specimen image shows a shallow, partly faint curving row of rounded chambers across irregular stone. Thin necks are less distinct than in the stylized model; count and precise S path are not specimen-derived.
inspection_note: Original final eight views were not replaced or cropped to conceal a defect. No new render was necessary after exact-geometry readback and personal full-view inspection.
